node.statement: Constant ledger and amplified setup. Let C_r,e_r; C_u,e_u; C_N,e_N be universal witnesses supplied respectively by lem-compcb-rectangular-product, lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action, and lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm, and let e_i be supplied by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities. Put K_p=C_r+1, K_a=2*C_r*(K_p+3)+1, C_ca=max{K_p,K_a,C_u,C_N}, and e_ca=min{e_r,e_u,e_N,e_i,1}. These are universal with C_ca finite and e_ca>0. For e=delta+epsilon<=e_ca, every cited external is applicable at every n>=1 to P_n=I_n tensor P and the amplified corner S_{P_n}=M_n tensor S_P.
